extra.Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite, React Router 6, TanStack Query 5, Axios, Capacitor 8 (Android), Shaka Player, SQLite (@capacitor-community/sqlite)
extra.Backend: separate repository (ET-Learn-Backend-v2) — NOT read for this document

nodes.name: Seafarer
nodes.description: Assigned learner (role `sea-farer`). Reaches courses through the console; training is bought by their employer.

nodes.name: Individual learner
nodes.description: B2C learner (role `individual-user`) who buys courses through the storefront.

nodes.name: LoginPage
nodes.description: Email/password form. Calls `signIn`, then `verifyOtpAndComplete` or `verifyTotpAndComplete` for the second factor, and navigates to `ROLE_HOME[role]`.

nodes.name: AuthProvider
nodes.description: Owns the session. Exposes `signIn`, `verifyOtpAndComplete`, `verifyTotpAndComplete`, `signOut`, `refreshUser`. Registers the global 401/403 handlers on apiClient.

nodes.name: authService
nodes.description: HTTP surface for login, logout, user-payload, OTP generate/verify, TOTP and set-cookie. No token is stored client-side; the session is an HTTP-only cookie.

nodes.name: apiClient
nodes.description: Shared Axios instance. `withCredentials` on all non-S3 requests, drops credentials for pre-signed S3, strips JSON content-type for FormData, and routes 401/403 to registered global handlers.

nodes.name: GET /auth/user-payload
nodes.description: Restores the authenticated user from the session cookie on boot. Allowlisted against the global 401 logout.

nodes.name: Offline session mirror
nodes.description: `rememberSession` / `recallSession` / `forgetSession`. Lets a boot with no connection restore the last known user instead of stranding a learner on the login screen.

nodes.name: ProtectedRoute
nodes.description: Shows a loader while the session restores, redirects unauthenticated users to /login preserving the intended URL, and sends a wrong-role user to `ROLE_HOME[role]`.

nodes.name: OfflineRouteGuard
nodes.description: Blocks routes that cannot work without a connection. Wraps the catalogue, course preview and the assessment route.

nodes.name: Session expired
nodes.description: A 401 on a non-allowlisted, non-S3 URL invokes the registered unauthorized handler.

nodes.name: CartPage
nodes.description: Cart contents, server-priced summary and the Razorpay checkout button. Hides all pricing and the pay button when the build ships no payment module.

nodes.name: CartProvider
nodes.description: Cart + wishlist state for the signed-in individual user. Exposes `addToCart`, `removeFromCart`, `addToWishlist`, `isInCart`, `cartCount` and `refresh`.

nodes.name: endUserService
nodes.description: B2C HTTP surface — catalogue, cart, wishlist, purchases, comments, subscription plans.

nodes.name: POST /individual-user/cart
nodes.description: Body carries `courseId`, `userId` and `subscriptionData` (the chosen pass).

nodes.name: paymentsEnabled()
nodes.description: `!Capacitor.isNativePlatform()`. The packaged Android build deliberately ships no payment module; the same bundle served to a browser takes payments normally.

nodes.name: paymentService
nodes.description: Razorpay order flow. All amounts are computed server-side in paise; the client never totals a cart.

nodes.name: POST /payments/cart-summary
nodes.description: Returns subtotal, discount, GST breakdown and grandTotal in paise.

nodes.name: POST /payments/razorpay/order
nodes.description: Creates a server-priced order and returns `keyId`, `razorpayOrderId`, `amount` and the prefill customer.

nodes.name: POST /payments/razorpay/verify
nodes.description: Verifies the checkout signature and triggers fulfilment. Returns `paymentApplied`.

nodes.name: GET /payments/:id/status
nodes.description: Polled when the webhook races fulfilment.

nodes.name: useCheckout
nodes.description: Drives load SDK → create order → open Razorpay → verify (+ poll up to 3× at 1.2s). Guards duplicate clicks with a synchronous ref and refuses outright when `paymentsEnabled()` is false.

nodes.name: Razorpay checkout.js
nodes.description: `https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js`, injected at most once behind a module-level promise.

nodes.name: PaymentSuccessDialog
nodes.description: Confirmation sheet reading a pre-checkout snapshot (the cart is cleared server-side by then). Bottom sheet on phones, centred dialog from `sm`.

nodes.name: MyLearningsPage
nodes.description: Enrolled courses with progress and status filters. Mirrors its own online response to SQLite so opening it once online makes it work offline.

nodes.name: CourseCard
nodes.description: Course tile — thumbnail, progress, status badge, offline-saved marker and the course download control.

nodes.name: CoursePlayerPage
nodes.description: Shared by both learner roles. Course header, curriculum playlist with lock state, and the lesson surface (video / COLREGS / document / SCORM).

nodes.name: courseData
nodes.description: `normalizeCourse`, `normalizeContent`, `applySequentialGate`, `courseCompletion`. One shape for the player and the offline mirror so a downloaded course renders identically.

nodes.name: applySequentialGate
nodes.description: A lesson stays locked until the item before it completes; a quiz video gates on its assessment being passed. Additive by default (only adds locks); `{ unlock: true }` makes the sequence authoritative for the offline rebuild.

nodes.name: courseAccess
nodes.description: The single source of truth for whether a learner may open a course. Returns a state (ACTIVE / COMPLETED / EXPIRED / LOCKED) plus per-capability flags. Derives the verdict from persisted facts so it holds with no connection.

nodes.name: seafarerService
nodes.description: Learner HTTP surface — courses, course content, learning paths, assessment questions/validation/attempts/review.

nodes.name: GET /sea-farer/course/:courseId/:userId
nodes.description: Course header plus `courseUser` (status, certificateNumber, subscriptionType) and the pass-access object.

nodes.name: GET /sea-farer/courseContent/:courseId/:userId
nodes.description: Separate `video[]` and `document[]` arrays that `normalizeContent` merges into one ordered playlist.

nodes.name: mediaService
nodes.description: Resolves playable URLs, persists watch progress and unlocks the next item.

nodes.name: GET /media/video/:courseId/:videoId
nodes.description: Signed playable URL (DASH .mpd / HLS .m3u8 / progressive .mp4). Returned as raw text or JSON-wrapped.

nodes.name: GET /media/COLREGS-Videos/:courseId/:videoId
nodes.description: Fixed sparse playlist of camera angles — [0] Main, [1] Thumbnail, [2] ECDIS, [3] Radar, [4] Monkey Island, [5] Port, [6] Starboard, [7] Stern, [8] Binocular.

nodes.name: PUT /media/video-progress
nodes.description: Upsert keyed on user+video. Also sent via `sendBeacon` on unmount so a navigation mid-lesson does not drop the save.

nodes.name: POST /media/enable-next-content
nodes.description: Unlocks the next content item once a video completes.

nodes.name: VideoPlayer
nodes.description: Shaka-based adaptive player with a custom "fit" control; falls back to a native `<video>` for progressive MP4. Keyed on its source so any source change remounts cleanly.

nodes.name: ColregsPlayer
nodes.description: Multi-view bridge simulation. Plays the bridge video through VideoPlayer and overlays a camera-view switcher fed from the sparse angle playlist.

nodes.name: SeafarerLearningPathsPage
nodes.description: A path as a guided journey — module list or timeline view, with a Continue-Learning panel and per-module download controls.

nodes.name: useSeafarerLearningPaths
nodes.description: Fetches and normalises the learner's paths — `queryFn` calls `seafarerService.fetchLearningPaths()`.

nodes.name: AssessmentPage
nodes.description: One question at a time with a per-question countdown, optional proctoring, and auto-submit after 6 serious violations or on timeout.

nodes.name: GET assessment questions
nodes.description: Questions for a content item. The company segment is omitted entirely for a B2C learner, who has no company.

nodes.name: POST validate assessment answer
nodes.description: Marked server-side per answer, carrying `assessmentUniqueId` so attempts group.

nodes.name: Proctoring strike limit
nodes.description: `STRIKE_LIMIT = 6` serious violations auto-submits the current selection.

nodes.name: TestHistoryPage
nodes.description: Every attempt grouped by course then test, with attempts, best score and latest date. Paginated 10 courses per page.

nodes.name: AttemptReviewDialog
nodes.description: Read-only answer-by-answer review of one graded attempt. Never reveals the correct answer for a question the learner did not attempt.

nodes.name: connectivity
nodes.description: One answer to "is there a connection?" for the whole app, seeded from `navigator.onLine` rather than assumed true, because a handset launched at sea never fires an `offline` event.

nodes.name: useOfflineQuery
nodes.description: Declares a server `queryFn` and a device `offlineFn` and owns the single rule for choosing between them — deciding again AFTER a failed attempt, not only before it.

nodes.name: offlineStore
nodes.description: Picks the backend once — SQLite + real files on Android, IndexedDB in a browser — and collapses concurrent saves of the same item into one download.

nodes.name: nativeStore
nodes.description: Android backend. Downloads into a `.incomplete` staging tree and only swaps it in once every file has landed, so a failed retry cannot destroy a working copy.

nodes.name: webStore
nodes.description: Browser backend — Shaka offline storage plus IndexedDB, resolving to blob URLs that the caller must revoke.

nodes.name: normalizedStore
nodes.description: Reads and writes the mirrored API tables. `upsertCourse` COALESCEs every column so a sparse list refresh cannot blank fields only the detail response carries.

nodes.name: learn_offline (SQLite)
nodes.description: Device database of records only — media lives on the filesystem and a row points at it.

nodes.name: courses
nodes.description: Mirrored course catalogue plus learner progress — status, progress, completedContent, and the entitlement facts subscriptionType / accessEndsAt / endsOnCompletion.

nodes.name: content_items
nodes.description: Curriculum rows with the frozen `payload` exactly as `normalizeContent` produced it. A pure server mirror — nothing ever marks it dirty.

nodes.name: watch_progress
nodes.description: What the learner has actually done. The record the sync layer pushes; carries the `isDirty` flag.

nodes.name: offline_videos
nodes.description: One row per downloaded lesson — mainPath, type, size, angleCount, owning userId, storageKey.

nodes.name: offline_assets
nodes.description: One row per COLREGS camera angle, keyed by lesson id and sparse playlist index.

nodes.name: Device filesystem
nodes.description: `Directory.External` (app-private space on the shared volume) with a fallback to internal `Directory.Data`. Holds DASH segments, progressive MP4s, documents and posters.

nodes.name: assetKeys
nodes.description: Naming rules. A signed CloudFront URL is transport, never identity — the storage key comes from the URL path, which only changes when the object does.

nodes.name: cacheWarmer
nodes.description: Mirrors My Learnings, each course's detail and its curriculum into SQLite, and refreshes server progress for rows the device does not owe.

nodes.name: useCourseDownload
nodes.description: Runs a whole-course download — mirrors the course for offline use, then downloads each item, and writes a record of what failed so the UI can report and retry.

nodes.name: downloadLesson
nodes.description: Resolves one item's sources and hands them to the store. A COLREGS lesson fails outright if no camera views come back — a bridge-only save is a simulation with every camera missing.

nodes.name: useOfflineDownloads
nodes.description: Shared list of saved items plus `isDownloaded`, `getOfflineUrl`, `getOfflineColregs` and the local resume position helpers.

nodes.name: readOfflineCurriculum
nodes.description: Rebuilds the curriculum from the frozen payload with locally-recorded progress laid over it, then re-gates the sequence so finishing a lesson at sea unlocks the next one.

nodes.name: recomputeCourseRollup
nodes.description: Restates the course summary from the same list the player renders, by the same rule, so the course page and My Learnings cannot disagree.

nodes.name: syncProgressToServer
nodes.description: Pushes dirty watch progress. Called by the sign-out flush in AuthContext, under a timeout cap.

nodes.name: syncWithServer
nodes.description: Pushes dirty watch-progress rows. Only progress travels — the server derives course status from it. A record loses its dirty flag only once the server has acknowledged it.

nodes.name: Download incomplete
nodes.description: A DASH download with missing or empty segments, or a progressive file short of its declared Content-Length, is rejected before it can commit.
